💔 In the Philippines, a woman risked everything in a fire to save what she valued most — her dogs

Early this morning, a massive fire broke out in Guizo, Mandaue City (Cebu, Philippines). The woman refused to leave anyone behind in the burning building.

Even at the most dangerous moment, she focused on saving her dogs first — and only afterward did a firefighter rescue her with the help of a ladder.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the ongoing civic development work on New Rohtak Road (Liberty Cinema Stretch) under Paharganj Traffic Area, traffic movement between Kamal T-Point and Gaushala Cut is expected to remain heavy / affected from 10.12.2025 to 31.12.2025.

📍 WORK IN PROGRESS:
* Pipeline Laying by Delhi Jal Board (DJB) – Trenching and pipeline installation have narrowed the road, restricting traffic flow to two lanes.
* 33 kV Cable Laying on New Rohtak Road & Ram Swaroop Vidyarthi Marg – Partial carriageway closures causing slow movement on the stretch.

📍 STRETCH AFFECTED:
Kamal T-Point ⇄ Gaushala Cut (New Rohtak Road – Liberty Cinema area)

📍 ADVISORY FOR COMMUTERS:
* Plan your journey in advance to avoid delays
* Slow movement expected near work zones
* Prefer alternate routes like Rani Jhansi Road & Pusa Road
* Drive cautiously and avoid unnecessary stopping/parking in the construction area

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels
